description: The command line accepted by every PL4G compiler implementation.  Both pypl4g and pl4gc parse this table, so that a build system need not know which implementation it is invoking.

commands.name: build
commands.help: compile the sources; with none named, run the build function in 'build.pl4g'.  What a command line naming no command means

commands.name: test
commands.help: run the tests of the sources: the `always` ones and the `suite` ones

commands.name: lsp
commands.help: speak the Language Server Protocol on stdin and stdout, compiling what an editor sends

options.help: write the output to FILE; the default is the first source renamed
stop after the named stage and write its result to the output file
generate code for TRIPLE
the microarchitecture level the generated program may use; x86-64 has v1 to v4 and uses v4 unless this says otherwise
set the optimization level
generate debugging information
enable the warning NAME; -Wno-NAME disables it
treat warnings as errors
colour the diagnostics; written with no value it means yes
render diagnostics as human-readable text or as JSON
colon-separated directories to look for modules in, after the directory of the importing file and before the system ones
run a test binary through COMMAND, for a target this machine does not run
tell the build function something: `std.option` answers with VALUE, or with 'true' where only NAME was written
how much room the program's own stack has; a number of bytes, or one with 'K', 'M' or 'G' after it.  Nought leaves the program on the stack the kernel gives it (default: 1M)
how much unreachable space sits below that stack, so that running off the bottom of it is caught rather than written through (default: 64K)
write the log of what the compiler reported and chose to FILE, in JSON
keep running, watch the inputs and patch the generated binary in place
report what the compiler is doing
report the time spent in each stage
describe the accepted options and exit
write this option table as JSON and exit
list the target triples this compiler can generate for, and exit
report the compiler version and exit
